replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: Yes, I used an AI tool to help with algebra problems last year. It explained steps clearly and adapted to my learning pace. I felt supported without frustration, which made complex topics easier to grasp.
replies.How would you explain, step by step, how: First, write the equation in standard form (ax² + bx + c = 0). Then, calculate the discriminant (b² - 4ac). If it’s positive, you get two real solutions; zero, one solution; negative, complex solutions. Use the quadratic formula: x = [-b ± √(b² - 4ac)] / (2a).

To find stationary points, take the first derivative f'(x), set it equal to zero, and solve for x. Then plug those x-values back into f(x) to get the y-values. These points are where the graph changes direction—peaks or valleys.
